item.title: Kenneth Walker: Expected back in Week 11
item.description:
Walker (groin), who won't play Sunday in Atlanta, is expected to "be able to go" next Sunday against the Cardinals, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Baker Mayfield: Managing injury to foot/ankle area
item.description:
Mayfield's availability for next Sunday's game against the Lions is in question due to an injury he sustained to his foot and ankle area during the Buccaneers' Week 9 loss to the Bears, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Davante Adams: Reportedly targeting Week 12 return
item.description:
According to Ian Rapoport of NFL Network and ESPN, Adams (hamstring) is believed to be targeting a return to action Nov. 25 against the Packers.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Puka Nacua: Has expected return date of mid-December
item.description:
Nacua (knee/toe) has an expected return date of "mid-December," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Drake Maye: Won't return Sunday
item.description:
Maye (ankle) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Lions, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
